node.title: DLI ell=1 weight-5 relations reduce to one squared-root hypersurface
node.statement: Over every odd field containing an element of order 512, normalized reduced weight-5 first-moment relations are in exact bijection with five-subsets of mu_256 having product one and satisfying one explicit degree-eight symmetric equation Psi=0. Psi is also the product of the 16 product-one square-root sums. Odd Galois dilation leaves exactly 289043 squared-root classes, versus 2296920 signed affine classes. This is an exact router and route-size fence, not an emptiness theorem.
